goal: Publish a verified shared geographic-search repair that fills recognized sparse city, town and region searches to at least 18 eligible places whenever the available eligible catalog permits it.

intent_model.literal_request: Always try to show at least 18 places, then continue with the closest places to the searched area, fix and publish with proof and no regression.
intent_model.implied_outcome: Sparse location searches remain useful and truthful across the whole VII place-search product.
likely_rejections: The public page still shows three

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Use a shared minimum for recognized city, town and region place searches, capped by the truthful eligible inventory.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: The full affected family must be tested and the public result count must reach 18 when at least 18 eligible places exist.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Deployment is part of the outcome and local-only evidence is insufficient.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: The exact deployed release and public natural destination require fresh verification.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: Search results for a selected location
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Show exact matches first and automatically extend with nearest eligible places
cognitive_flow.next_action: Open a result without needing to restart the search

natural_destination: Public VII result pages on desktop and mobile, starting with the supplied משמר הירדן URL

facts.claim: The current public supplied URL shows 3 exact places.
facts.evidence: Fresh in-app browser accessibility snapshot on 2026-10-23.

facts.claim: The shared implementation currently completes sparse place searches to 3 and caps recommendations at 12.

assumptions.claim: At least 18 eligible vacation places have geographic anchors relative to משמר הירדן.
assumptions.validation: Focused catalog test and public post-deploy result count.

in_scope: Shared 18-result minimum for recognized sparse place searches
Preservation of dates, availability and filters
Vacation, events, spa, hourly and managed search landings
Counts, list, map, disclosure and structured data consistency
invariants: Unknown locations never receive arbitrary catalog-order results
Whole-country searches are not padded or limited by the sparse-location contract
No unavailable or filter-ineligible item is introduced
The searched location remains in the URL, heading and breadcrumbs
Existing card design and content remain intact
affected_family: Vacation location result pages and semantic regional routes
Event venue location result pages and semantic regional routes
Spa location result pages and semantic regional routes
Hourly-room location result pages and semantic regional routes
Shared list, map, result-count, disclosure and structured-data inventory

requirements.statement: Recognized sparse city, town or region searches append nearest eligible distinct places until 18 results or eligible inventory exhaustion.
Exact matches remain first and nearby additions are ordered nearest to farthest.
Dates, availability, online-only, capacity, price, type and feature filters remain hard constraints.
List, map, count, disclosure and structured result data agree with the completed inventory.
The change applies consistently across vacation, events, spa, hourly and managed place-search pages.
The exact tested release is published and verified on the supplied public URL on desktop and mobile.

acceptance_checks.setup: Known location with 3 exact and at least 18 eligible anchored places
acceptance_checks.observable_result: 18 distinct results, exact three first, remaining 15 ordered by distance

acceptance_checks.setup: Eligible pool contains fewer than 18 places
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Every eligible distinct place is shown and no result is fabricated

acceptance_checks.setup: Nearby inventory contains unavailable and filter-ineligible places
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Only the prefiltered eligible pool can appear

acceptance_checks.setup: Representative routes in each place world
acceptance_checks.action: Search, open map, reload and revisit
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Completed inventory and selected state remain consistent

acceptance_checks.setup: Exact immutable release candidate passed all gates
acceptance_checks.action: Publish once and poll bounded deployment state
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Terminal successful deployment or fail closed without an uncertain retry

acceptance_checks.action: Verify retained rollback target before publishing

authorization_boundary: The current request authorizes implementation and public deployment after gates pass; no supplier write, booking, payment, message, secret or destructive operation is authorized.
